description_en: Updates a business metric. Release version: v5.5.0
description_zh:
更新业务指标。
发布版本号：v5.5.0
name: UpdateBizMetric

fields.help_en: The associated technical metrics. Enter the technical metric in the "Full table name.Metric name" format, where the "Full table name" is equal to "Asset source.Table name". A technical metric can be associated with only one business metric and cannot be repeatedly associated
fields.help_zh: 关联的技术指标列表。请填写技术指标的“所属表全名.指标名称”，其中“所属表全名”等于“资产来源.所属表名”。一个技术指标只能被一个业务指标关联，无法重复关联
fields.name: associated_tech_metric_full_names

fields.help_en: The business owner. Enter the username of the owner's account
fields.help_zh: 业务负责人，请填写负责人账号的用户名
fields.name: biz_owner_name

fields.help_en: The IDs of the parent folders
fields.help_zh: 归属目录ID列表
fields.name: catalog_ids

fields.help_en: The code of the custom attribute
fields.help_zh: 自定义属性编码
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: The attribute values. 1. For custom input and drop-down single-select attributes, only the first attribute value in the list is read. 2. For drop-down multi-select attributes, all attribute values in the list are read. 3. For hyperlink attributes, the first attribute value in the list is read as the display text, and the second attribute value is read as the redirect link
fields.help_zh: 属性值列表：1、自定义输入和下拉单选属性仅读取列表第一个属性值；2、下拉多选属性，读取列表全部属性值；3、超链接属性，读取列表第一个属性值作为展示文本，第二个属性值作为跳转链接
fields.name: values

fields.help_en: The custom attributes. Enter the attribute code and attribute value separately
fields.help_zh: 自定义属性列表，请分别填写属性编码及属性值
fields.name: custom_attribute

fields.help_en: The description
fields.help_zh: 描述
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The display name
fields.help_zh: 展示名称
fields.name: display_name

fields.help_en: The asset labels
fields.help_zh: 资产标签
fields.name: labels

fields.help_en: The metric definition. To reference other business metrics, enclose the metric names in half-width square brackets []
fields.help_zh: 指标口径，如需引用其他业务指标，请使用半角中括号[ ]包裹指标名称
fields.name: metric_definition

fields.help_en: The expression for the metric relationship diagram. This parameter is read only when the metric relationship diagram is enabled. You can only enter a calculation expression composed of metric names selected from the related business metrics. The supported operators are +, -, *, /, (), %, and ∑. Each metric name must be enclosed in half-width square brackets []. If no operator is specified between two metrics, the system automatically adds padding as a placeholder. If the metric relational expression is not configured, a shutdown of the metric relationship diagram switch is automatically triggered
fields.help_zh: 仅当“指标关系图”开启时会读取此信息。仅支持填写从“相关业务指标”中选取的指标名称组成的一个计算表达式，运算符号仅支持+、-、*、/、（）、%、∑，各指标名称需用半角中括号[ ]包裹。如果两个指标之间未填写运算符，系统将自动填充占位符。如果未配置指标关系表达式，则“指标关系图”开关将自动关闭
fields.name: metric_relation_diagram_expression

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the metric relationship diagram. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.
This switch can be enabled only when at least one related business metric exists. Otherwise, it is automatically disabled
fields.help_zh: 指标关系图开关：true开启；false关闭。当且仅当至少有一个“相关业务指标”时可开启，否则会自动关闭
fields.name: metric_relation_diagram_switch_open

fields.help_en: The name of the business metric to update
fields.help_zh: 请输入需要更新的业务指标的名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The new name. Specify this parameter when you need to modify the metric name
fields.help_zh: 更新后的名称，当您需要修改指标名称时输入
fields.name: new_name

fields.help_en: The content of the usage instructions. Only text format is supported
fields.help_zh: 使用说明内容，仅支持文本格式
fields.name: operate_instruction_content

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the usage instructions. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
fields.help_zh: 使用说明是否开启：true开启；false关闭
fields.name: operate_instruction_enabled

fields.help_en: The name of the business metric
fields.help_zh: 业务指标名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The relationship type. Valid values:
POSITIVE: Positive correlation.
NEGATIVE: Negative correlation.
OTHER: Other
fields.help_zh: 关联关系：POSITIVE正相关；NEGATIVE负相关；OTHER其他
fields.name: relation_type

fields.help_en: The related business metrics
fields.help_zh: 相关业务指标列表
fields.name: related_biz_metrics

fields.help_en:
The visibility scope type. Valid values:
ALL_USERS_CAN_VIEW: Visible to all users.
PART_USERS_CAN_VIEW: Visible to specific users.
PART_USERS_CAN_NOT_VIEW: Invisible to specific users
fields.help_zh: 可见范围类型：ALL_USERS_CAN_VIEW全部用户可见；PART_USERS_CAN_VIEW部分用户可见；PART_USERS_CAN_NOT_VIEW部分用户不可见
fields.name: scope_type

fields.help_en: The user group names. This parameter is read only when the visibility scope of the asset is set to Visible to specific users or Invisible to specific users
fields.help_zh: 请填写用户组名称，当且仅当资产“可见范围”为“部分用户可见”或“部分用户不可见”时会读取此信息
fields.name: user_group_names

fields.help_en: The usernames of individual accounts. This parameter is valid only when the visibility scope of the asset is set to Visible to specific users or Invisible to specific users
fields.help_zh: 请填写个人账号的用户名，当且仅当资产“可见范围”为“部分用户可见”或“部分用户不可见”时有效
fields.name: user_names

fields.help_en: The visibility scope
fields.help_zh: 可见范围
fields.name: view_scope

Code.description_en: The error code. A value of OK indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 请求错误码, OK表示请求正常
Code.title_en: 请求错误码, OK表示请求正常
Code.title_zh: 请求错误码, OK表示请求正常

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the update is successful. Valid values:
true: The update is successful.
false: The update fails
Success.description_zh: 是否更新成功：true成功；false失败
Success.title_en: 是否更新成功：true成功；false失败
Success.title_zh: 是否更新成功：true成功；false失败
